framework.name: AI Governance and Strategy Assessment Framework
framework.topicDescription: This framework assesses how effectively companies manage AI-related risks and opportunities across the wider economy. It is sector-agnostic and applies globally, focusing on regulatory filings as primary evidence sources. The framework evaluates AI strategy, deployment, governance, policies, performance measurement, talent, partnerships, community engagement, and risk disclosure. It includes measures for AI safety, third-party AI risk management, and incident disclosure. Evidence from the past 3 years is considered valid unless explicitly reversed. Both AI and ML are included, but data analysis is excluded. Any form of policy publication is acceptable, and quantification can include financial effects or other metrics. Standard cloud contracts without specific AI reference do not count as strategic partnerships. Sustainability reports are secondary evidence, and third-party reports are acceptable if quoting primary text. CDP is not a priority source but is not excluded.

measures.title: Does the company name AI as a stated strategic priority?
measures.definition: Captures the existence threshold for AI strategy — companies that publicly identify AI as a strategic priority in CEO communications, annual reports or strategy sections, even without a fully developed time-bound plan. Lower bar than 1.1.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Explicit statement in CEO letter, Chair statement or strategy section that AI is a strategic priority, focus area, or core enabler.","no":"AI is only referenced in passing, only in risk-factor context, or only as part of an undifferentiated technology bundle.","partial":"AI is mentioned as a strategic priority in one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Generic technology-transformation language without AI specificity"],"required_evidence_type":"Explicit statement in CEO letter, Chair statement or strategy section.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Does the company state a formal AI strategy with defined objectives?
measures.definition: Tests for a structured strategic plan beyond priority-signalling — time-bound objectives, workstreams or quantified resource allocation tied specifically to AI.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Time-bound AI objectives tied to named workstreams or business units, with quantified resource allocation.","no":"Priority statements without dates, workstreams or resource allocation.","partial":"AI strategy is detailed for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Priority statements without dates or resource allocation"],"required_evidence_type":"Time-bound AI objectives with quantified resource allocation.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Is AI mentioned as a material driver of the company's competitive strategy?
measures.definition: Tests whether AI is explicitly linked to competitive advantage, differentiation, moat or market position — not just listed as a capability.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"AI is explicitly linked to competitive advantage, differentiation, pricing power or market position.","no":"AI is listed as a capability without competitive framing.","partial":"AI is mentioned as a competitive driver in one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Statements that AI is important to the industry without linking it to the company's own competitive position"],"required_evidence_type":"Explicit linkage of AI to competitive advantage or market position.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Does the company distinguish between traditional/predictive AI and generative AI in its disclosures?
measures.definition: Tests disclosure maturity — companies that distinguish predictive ML from generative AI demonstrate technical fluency and more granular risk awareness.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Both traditional/predictive AI and generative AI terminology are used with separate context, treatments or use cases.","no":"Only one type is referenced or the two are used interchangeably.","partial":"Both terms are used but not with distinct context.","explicit_exclusions":["Only one term used throughout"],"required_evidence_type":"Explicit use of both terms with distinct context.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Does the company disclose readiness for emerging AI regulations?
measures.definition: Tests forward-looking compliance posture against named regulatory regimes. Material for cross-border issuers exposed to multiple emerging AI rule-sets.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Named reference to specific regulatory regimes and description of an internal readiness action.","no":"Only generic regulatory awareness is disclosed.","partial":"Specific regulatory regimes are named but no internal readiness action is described.","explicit_exclusions":["Generic references to \"AI regulation\" without naming specific regimes"],"required_evidence_type":"Named reference to specific regulatory regimes and internal readiness action.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Does the company reference multiple AI use cases qualitatively?
measures.definition: Captures the existence of plural AI activity even when the company has not disclosed an exact count.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"References at least two distinct AI use cases, applications or deployments.","no":"Only one or zero use cases are identified.","partial":"AI use cases are mentioned in one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Single AI use case mentioned in isolation"],"required_evidence_type":"Plural references to AI use cases tied to named business areas.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Does the company disclose a specific number of AI use cases (in production or piloting)?
measures.definition: Tests for quantified disclosure of AI deployment breadth.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Specific numeric count of AI use cases, applications or projects is disclosed.","no":"Only plural references without numbers are provided.","partial":"Specific count is disclosed for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Vague magnitude language without specific figures"],"required_evidence_type":"Explicit number of AI use cases disclosed.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Has the company stated any AI use case as in production?
measures.definition: Tests whether AI activity has moved beyond pilots — captures companies with deployed AI even when they do not break out production vs pilot counts.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"At least one AI use case is described as deployed, in production or operationally generating value.","no":"All AI activity is described as pilot, experimental or under development.","partial":"AI use case is in production in one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["All AI use cases described as pilots without production rollout"],"required_evidence_type":"Description of AI use case as deployed or in production.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Does the company disclose a breakdown of AI use cases by production vs pilot stage?
measures.definition: The advanced disclosure marker for AI deployment maturity.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Quantified counts of AI use cases broken out by deployment stage with at least production-vs-pilot distinction.","no":"Only aggregate AI use case counts without stage breakdown are provided.","partial":"Breakdown is provided for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Production-only or pilot-only counts without a comparison split"],"required_evidence_type":"Quantified breakdown of AI use cases by deployment stage.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Does the company provide qualitative descriptions of AI use cases in key business areas?
measures.definition: Tests substantive disclosure of what AI is actually doing in the business — beyond counts or strategy statements.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Specific qualitative descriptions of AI use cases in at least one named business area, with described function and scope.","no":"Descriptions are purely generic without functional detail.","partial":"Descriptions are provided for one business area but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Generic statements without specific application"],"required_evidence_type":"Qualitative descriptions of AI use cases with functional detail.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Is AI risk or oversight discussed by the board in proxy or 10-K?
measures.definition: Captures board engagement with AI even where committee charters have not yet been formally amended.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Proxy statement, AGM circular, 10-K or 20-F explicitly references board-level AI discussion, review or oversight.","no":"AI is only addressed at management level or only in technology-bundled board oversight language.","partial":"AI is discussed by the board in one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["AI mentioned only in management-level disclosures without board reference"],"required_evidence_type":"Explicit reference to board-level AI discussion or oversight.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Does the board (or a board committee) have an explicit, documented charter mandate for AI strategy and risk?
measures.definition: The advanced governance marker — tests formal codification of AI oversight in committee charters.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"A named board committee charter explicitly includes AI strategy or AI risk in its written mandate.","no":"AI is only discussed without charter codification.","partial":"AI is included in the charter for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Charters that reference \"emerging technology\" without AI specificity"],"required_evidence_type":"Explicit inclusion of AI in board committee charter.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Has the company appointed a named senior executive accountable for AI?
measures.definition: Tests whether there is named, attributable accountability for AI at executive level.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Named individual with explicit AI title or stated portfolio in proxy or annual report.","no":"AI accountability is implicit in a broader technology role.","partial":"AI accountability is named for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["CTO or CIO without explicit AI portfolio specified"],"required_evidence_type":"Named senior executive with explicit AI accountability.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Has the company established a cross-functional AI governance/ethics committee at management level?
measures.definition: Tests for a named management body that brings legal, risk, technology, business and ethics functions together on AI decisions.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Named management committee with AI in its remit and cross-functional membership disclosed.","no":"AI governance sits within a single function or has no named body.","partial":"AI governance committee is established for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Single-function AI working groups without named scope or charter"],"required_evidence_type":"Named cross-functional AI governance committee with stated remit.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Does the company disclose AI safety and robustness testing practices?
measures.definition: Tests whether the company conducts and discloses practices like red-teaming, adversarial testing, or model evaluation before deployment.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Company discloses specific AI safety and robustness testing practices.","no":"No disclosure of AI safety or robustness testing practices.","partial":"AI safety practices are disclosed for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Generic statements about AI safety without specific practices"],"required_evidence_type":"Disclosure of specific AI safety and robustness testing practices.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Has the company referenced an internal AI policy or guidelines?
measures.definition: Captures companies with internal AI controls that have not yet published the policy publicly.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Explicit reference to an internal AI policy, guidelines, or acceptable-use document.","no":"AI is only addressed within broader IT or data policies without specific AI reference.","partial":"Internal AI policy is referenced for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Reference to broader internal IT or data policies without AI specificity"],"required_evidence_type":"Explicit reference to internal AI policy or guidelines.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Has the company published a formal AI policy, principles, or responsible-AI framework?
measures.definition: Tests for public, downloadable AI policy artefact — the advanced disclosure marker.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Public AI policy document, responsible-AI principles document or AI framework available on the issuer's website or filed publicly.","no":"AI policy is only internal or only embedded in non-policy material.","partial":"AI policy is published for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Internal-only policies without public disclosure"],"required_evidence_type":"Public AI policy document or responsible-AI principles.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Does the company describe how AI principles are operationalised (controls, processes, KPIs)?
measures.definition: Tests whether published principles are linked to operational mechanisms — controls, processes, KPIs, training, audits.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Describes at least two specific operational mechanisms tied to its AI principles.","no":"Only principles are disclosed without operational detail.","partial":"Operational mechanisms are described for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Principle statements without operational mechanism"],"required_evidence_type":"Description of operational mechanisms tied to AI principles.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Does the AI policy explicitly cover data security and personal data privacy?
measures.definition: Tests whether AI-specific data risks are addressed in the AI policy itself — not just inherited from a general data policy.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"AI policy explicitly addresses both data security and personal data privacy with AI-specific application.","no":"Only one is addressed or coverage is generic.","partial":"Data security and privacy are addressed for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["General data privacy policy without AI-specific application"],"required_evidence_type":"AI policy addressing data security and personal data privacy.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Does the company have a policy for managing third-party AI risks?
measures.definition: Tests whether the company has a policy for managing risks associated with AI from vendors or embedded AI in purchased software.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Company discloses a policy for managing third-party AI risks.","no":"No disclosure of third-party AI risk management policy.","partial":"Third-party AI risk management is disclosed for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Generic vendor risk management without AI specificity"],"required_evidence_type":"Policy for managing third-party AI risks.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Does the company reference internally tracked AI metrics qualitatively?
measures.definition: Captures companies that have AI measurement infrastructure but have not disclosed the specific numbers.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Narrative reference to tracking AI performance, AI adoption, AI use case metrics or AI ROI internally.","no":"Metric tracking is only generic technology monitoring.","partial":"AI metrics are tracked for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["References to monitoring \"technology performance\" without AI specificity"],"required_evidence_type":"Narrative reference to AI-specific metrics or KPIs.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Does the company disclose quantified AI-specific KPIs that it tracks internally?
measures.definition: Tests for disclosed numeric AI KPIs with metric definition.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Specific numeric KPI with metric definition is disclosed.","no":"All measurement disclosure is qualitative or generic.","partial":"Quantified AI KPIs are disclosed for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Qualitative references to tracking metrics without numbers"],"required_evidence_type":"Specific numeric AI-specific KPI with metric definition.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Does the company qualitatively attribute revenue or cost impact to AI?
measures.definition: Captures attribution of AI to financial outcomes even without dollar figures.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Narrative attribution of cost savings, productivity uplift, revenue contribution or efficiency gain to AI deployment.","no":"Attribution is only forward-looking or absent.","partial":"AI financial impact is attributed for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Generic statements that AI \"will create value\" without describing realised impact"],"required_evidence_type":"Narrative attribution of AI to financial outcomes.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Does the company disclose quantified AI-attributable revenue or cost savings?
measures.definition: Tests for specific dollar, percentage or volume figures attributable to AI deployment.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Specific $ or % figure attributable to AI is disclosed.","no":"Attribution is qualitative or forward-looking only.","partial":"Quantified AI financial impact is disclosed for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Methodology-free numbers without disclosed scope or accounting basis"],"required_evidence_type":"Quantified, realised AI-attributable financial impact with stated scope.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Has the company stated a commitment to AI reskilling or upskilling?
measures.definition: Captures stated commitments to workforce AI transition even before a named programme is in place.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Public commitment to reskill or upskill workforce for AI.","no":"AI training is only addressed within generic L&D language.","partial":"AI reskilling commitment is stated for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Generic learning-and-development statements without AI specificity"],"required_evidence_type":"Public commitment to AI reskilling or upskilling.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Has the company established a named workforce AI reskilling/upskilling programme?
measures.definition: Tests for a named, scoped AI training programme — the advanced workforce marker.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Named programme with described scope and structure.","no":"AI reskilling is only a stated commitment without a named programme.","partial":"AI reskilling programme is established for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Commitment without programme name"],"required_evidence_type":"Named AI reskilling programme with stated scope.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Does the company disclose the number of employees that completed AI training in the reporting year?
measures.definition: Tests for quantified workforce coverage of AI training.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Specific number or percentage of employees who completed AI training is disclosed.","no":"Coverage is not quantified.","partial":"AI training headcount is disclosed for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Training hours or training spend without participant counts"],"required_evidence_type":"Quantified AI training headcount or percentage.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Has the company disclosed strategic partnerships with foundation-model providers or hyperscalers?
measures.definition: Tests for disclosed strategic relationships with AI infrastructure or model providers.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Named strategic AI partner with described scope of the relationship.","no":"Partnerships are only listed by logo or generically referenced.","partial":"Strategic AI partnership is disclosed for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Off-the-shelf cloud or SaaS contracts without AI-specific framing"],"required_evidence_type":"Named strategic AI partner with described scope.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Does the company support AI literacy or digital-skills initiatives in the wider community?
measures.definition: Tests for external AI literacy or digital skills programmes beyond the issuer's own workforce.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Named external AI literacy or digital skills initiative with stated reach.","no":"Community AI engagement is generic or absent.","partial":"AI literacy initiative is supported for one community but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Internal employee training without community scope"],"required_evidence_type":"Named external AI literacy or digital skills initiative.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.title: Does the company engage in public policy advocacy related to AI ethics and governance?
measures.definition: Tests for substantive AI policy engagement — coalition membership, policy submissions, named advocacy positions.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Named membership of AI-specific policy or governance body with disclosed scope.","no":"AI advocacy is only addressed within general lobbying disclosures.","partial":"AI policy advocacy is engaged for one policy area but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["General trade association memberships without AI-specific working groups"],"required_evidence_type":"Named AI policy or governance engagement with disclosed scope.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.category: AI Risk Disclosure and Capital Allocation
measures.title: Does the company disclose AI as a material risk factor in its 10-K, 20-F or equivalent annual filing?
measures.definition: Tests for AI in the risk-factor section of regulatory annual filings.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"AI is named in the risk-factor section of regulatory filings.","no":"AI is only bundled into broader technology risk language.","partial":"AI risk is disclosed for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["AI referenced only in MD&A or business sections without inclusion in risk factors"],"required_evidence_type":"AI named in the risk-factor section of regulatory filings.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.category: AI Risk Disclosure and Capital Allocation
measures.title: Does the company quantify AI-related capex, R&D investment, or infrastructure commitment?
measures.definition: Tests for quantified disclosure of capital allocated to AI.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Specific $ figure for AI-related capex, AI infrastructure, AI compute, AI data centre build-out, AI model development or AI-focused R&D is disclosed.","no":"AI investment is bundled into broader technology spend.","partial":"AI capex or R&D is quantified for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Total technology or digital capex without AI separation"],"required_evidence_type":"Specific $ figure for AI capex or R&D with disclosed methodology.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.category: AI Risk Disclosure and Capital Allocation
measures.title: Does the company disclose AI as a competitive risk to its existing business model?
measures.definition: Tests for defensive disclosure — companies that publicly acknowledge AI disruption risk to their own revenue model, pricing power or distribution demonstrate strategic awareness.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"AI is explicitly disclosed as a potential competitive risk to the company's own business model, revenue or market position.","no":"AI is only framed as opportunity or only as enterprise-risk-management exposure without addressing competitive substitution risk to the business model.","partial":"AI competitive risk is disclosed for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Generic competitive risk disclosure without AI specificity"],"required_evidence_type":"Explicit disclosure of AI as a competitive risk to the business model.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}

measures.category: AI Risk Disclosure and Capital Allocation
measures.title: Has the company disclosed any AI-related incidents or near-misses?
measures.definition: Tests whether the company has disclosed any incidents or near-misses related to AI, demonstrating transparency and risk management.
measures.scoringGuidance: {"yes":"Company discloses specific AI-related incidents or near-misses.","no":"No disclosure of AI-related incidents or near-misses.","partial":"AI incidents are disclosed for one division but not enterprise-wide.","explicit_exclusions":["Generic incident disclosure without AI specificity"],"required_evidence_type":"Disclosure of specific AI-related incidents or near-misses.","temporal_note":"Score based on most recent disclosure only."}
